gaps: The new case 'Maintained setup retains actual owner verification through ten native calls and preserves configured environment' cannot run on the pinned rc3 SDK (no `product.constructAdmissionCapabilityData`). End-to-end proof requires the C2-built candidate package and its refreshed candidate basis.

Two checks in the new case were checked by reading source only, not by execution: the verified artifact keeps object identity through admission, and the request is compared by content plus `selectOwnedProductVerification` (valibot rebuilds the request object).
The t287-w2-05 required case skips unless ABI5_PREPARATION_RESOLVE_CALL is set. C2 must point it at artifacts/setup020/preparation-resolve-call.json after the harness run.
The new case writes artifacts/setup020/* with exclusive create ('wx'), so a rerun needs that directory cleared first.
The new case needs an npm executable on the ambient PATH with a usable offline cache, and /usr/bin/tar.
Only PATH and TMPDIR are scoped. Install npm inherits the rest of the ambient environment, so other configured setupEnvironment keys such as npm_config_* no longer reach the install npm.

exact-candidate-qualification.mjs still reads the recorded calls/catalog-admit.outcome.json back as input and makes in-process eventless calls outside the setup environment scope. This is existing qualification behavior and was left as is.

The program-count limits in the new case (at most one link program; programs only in the two verification phases and right after product-verify-1) are based on rc3 counts. The candidate's counts have not been observed.
Phase timings are reported but no timing target is asserted.
All self-run checks are author feedback, not independent acceptance.
authorReport.summary:
The maintained-setup change is in place but not proven end to end: the new harness case fails on the pinned rc3 SDK, which lacks the HC2 export `constructAdmissionCapabilityData`. All 25 existing harness cases pass there. Nothing is committed and no acceptance is claimed. Full record: rc4-scratch/native-recovery-20/return.json.

Changes, over custody 45554d0b:
- Design doc T287_PUBLIC_DEFINITION_CALL_CONSTRUCTION.md: added the accepted HOW paragraph on maintained setup owner reuse, plus a short sequence diagram.
- public-setup.mjs: `publicCaller.invoke` now passes the actual constructed call to `runtime.api.runInstalledDefinitionCallTransport` in the same installed module instance. It records compact request/resource coordinates, the real SDK outcome, the close handoff and timing. The setup JSONL file, the per-call CLI child and the stdout parser are gone. `populateSandbox` sets the configured PATH/TMPDIR for the whole serial setup and restores the ambient values in finally. There is no timeout race.
- runner.mjs: added one named cold entry, `invokeColdInstalledEntry` (one JSONL request to a fresh installed CLI process). Fresh reads and lifecycle start both use it; lifecycle keeps its supervision environment.
- harness.test.mjs: adapted three existing cases to the cold entry, and appended the required provider-free real case. It writes artifacts/setup020/preparation-resolve-call.json and the receipt beside it.
- t287-w2-05-static-binding-algebra.test.mjs: one passive change. It now reads the saved receipt beside the call file; the old path mapping cannot find it under artifacts/setup020.
- exact-candidate-qualification.mjs is untouched; no reason to change it was demonstrated.

Checks (author feedback only):
- `node --check` passes on all four edited .mjs files.
- Harness run against the pinned rc3 SDK, in a scratch copy linked to that build: 25 of 26 top-level cases pass. The only failure is the new case, on the missing export above.
- A separate scratch probe (observer-check.mjs) against the real rc3 code confirmed the heavy-work counting the new case uses. Core verification builds one declaration-closure program, consumer verification builds none and lock construction builds one link program. Reusing an already-verified value triggers no re-verification or re-link. A raw copy is verified again from scratch.
- Pinned type-check (noEmit) was not run because no TypeScript source changed.
